explanation: Move each letter of HAL one place along the alphabet and you get IBM. Arthur C. Clarke, who co-wrote the story, insisted this was a coincidence.

claims.text: The ship's computer in 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968) is HAL 9000.
Skynet is the computer of The Terminator films, Mother is the ship's computer in Alien, and Deep Thought is the computer in The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.
Moving each letter of HAL one place forward in the alphabet gives IBM.
Arthur C. Clarke, who wrote the screenplay with Stanley Kubrick, said the link between HAL and IBM was a coincidence.
